item.title: 盘屿 0.9.10
item.description:
盘屿 0.9.10
· 支持同一块盘同时运行两个拷贝任务；同名文件和重叠目录自动排队，暂停、继续与取消各自独立。 · 改进暂停后继续的进度与速度显示，分别显示核对速度和传输速度，并说明复用的已有内容。 · 优化选择源文件和目标位置的响应，减少两步切换等待，独立记住源文件目录。 · 加强取消、断盘与重连时的任务保护，避免清理其他任务的未完成文件。
对应源码：https://qisw.top/volisle/updates/Volisle-0.9.10-85-source.tar.gz

Volisle 0.9.10
· Run up to two copy tasks on the same disk. Conflicting files and folders wait their turn; pause, resume and cancel each task independently. · Show separate comparison and transfer speeds after resuming, with a clear summary of existing data reused. · Improve source and destination selection by reducing two-step window transition delays and remembering the source folder separately. · Strengthen task protection during cancellation, disconnection and reconnection so one task cannot remove another task's partial files.
Source code: https://qisw.top/volisle/updates/Volisle-0.9.10-85-source.tar.gz
